q1.a:
Absolutely. At Bijou Monde we work with real materials: .925 Sterling Silver, 10K and 14K gold with a purity hallmark, and 316L surgical stainless steel — resistant and hypoallergenic.

Every piece is carefully selected to offer you quality, durability, and safety in what you wear.

q2.a: Yes, we ship to every state in Mexico with insured carriers and real-time tracking. Estimated delivery is 2 to 5 business days once your order is processed. We do not currently offer international shipping.

q3.q: How do I know my ring size?
q3.a:
At Bijou Monde we want your piece to fit perfectly from the very first moment. To find your ideal size, we recommend following our Size Guide, where you can use two simple and accurate methods:

• Diameter method: Use a ring that fits you well and measure its inner diameter with a millimeter ruler.
• Consult the chart: Compare the measurement in millimeters with our equivalence table to identify your size.

Tip: If you are between two sizes, we recommend choosing the larger one for greater comfort, especially for thicker designs.

q4.a: Applicable VAT (IVA, 16%; gold jewelry is exempt) is calculated and itemized at checkout before you confirm payment. Since all shipments are domestic, there are no customs fees or import duties.

q5.q: What payment methods do you accept?
q5.a:
We accept a range of secure payment methods, all processed through Stripe with buyer protection and bank-level data encryption:
• Credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, and other major cards)
• Digital wallets (Apple Pay and Google Pay)
• Bank transfer (SPEI)
• Cash at any OXXO store (for orders under $10,000 MXN)

q7.q: How do I care for my jewelry?
q7.a:
Caring for your Bijou Monde pieces is simpler than it seems.

To keep their shine and appearance for longer, we recommend:
• Cleaning them occasionally with a soft cloth
• Avoiding contact with perfumes, creams, and chemicals
• Removing them before bathing, swimming, or exercising
• Storing them in a dry place and separated to avoid scratches

With these basic steps, your jewelry will stay in excellent condition and ready to wear every day.

q6.q: Do pieces tarnish or lose their shine?
q6.a:
Like any jewelry, our pieces may show slight changes with wear and time. Materials like silver can darken, and the shine of gold or steel may soften slightly depending on daily use.

The good news is that this can be easily prevented and maintained.

To keep your pieces in top condition, we recommend:
• Avoiding contact with perfumes, creams, and chemicals such as chlorine
• Removing them before bathing or exercising
• Storing them in a dry place, separate from other pieces
• Cleaning them occasionally with a soft cloth

With these simple steps, your Bijou Monde jewelry can maintain its shine and elegance for much longer.

Because it's not just about having a piece of jewelry… it's about keeping it flawless every time you choose to wear it.

s1.title: Excellence at the Heart of Mexico's Jewelry District
s1.body: Located in the prestigious Magno Centro Joyero of Guadalajara, Bijou Monde is a firm specializing in the selection and commercialization of high-end jewelry. Our operation is distinguished by a rigorous focus on material quality, offering exclusive pieces in Gold, Silver, and high-resistance Steel for a global audience seeking distinction and durability.

s2.title: Our Proposition
s2.body: At Bijou Monde, we understand that jewelry is an investment in style and legacy. That is why we are not simply distributors; we are expert selectors. Every piece in our catalog has been chosen under strict standards of minimalist design and technical excellence, guaranteeing flawless finishes that meet the expectations of the most discerning international market.
